title: Fail closed on malformed active network claims
summary: Fail closed when any persisted active network claim cannot be reconstructed.
reason: Remediate P1 AUDIT-FIND-W01-018. Current bundled-runtime reproduction returned success and activated only job-valid from a two-job registry containing one malformed active claim.
behavior_before: Registry recovery logged and skipped malformed or incomplete active jobs, installed the remaining subset, and returned success to coordinator startup.
behavior_after: Recovery requires a jobs array and validates every active claim's object shape, job/worker/source identity, claim timing, encode configuration, claim metadata, and typed fields before installing any state. Any failure returns false, preserves prior memory and source bytes, and emits a bounded redacted error so coordinator startup refuses new claims.
tests_added: tests/python/desktop/test_network_registry_recovery_fail_closed.py: mixed-valid/corrupt ownership, identity/config/rerun-metadata matrix, source preservation, prior-memory preservation, and coordinator startup refusal regressions.
manual_validation: Broad network registry/coordinator/rerun/protocol suite - passed: 210 tests, 136 subtests
Bundled-Python disposable reproduction before remediation: load_returned=True and only job-valid recovered; original state file remained unchanged.
Focused registry split suite - passed: 20 tests, 4 subtests
Independent disposable proof - passed: malformed load returned false, prior memory and source bytes were preserved, and no partial claim activated
One initial disposable probe used the wrong snapshot DTO field and was corrected immediately; it changed no repository or persistent state.
Project index, feature map, lifecycle map, architecture guardrails, and naming lint checks - passed
Summary-integrity/risky-file/AI-guardrail tests - passed: 30 tests, 57 subtests; lifecycle-map tests - passed: 3 tests
ai_guardrail postflight - only separate finding-backed failures AUDIT-FIND-COV-001, AUDIT-FIND-DEP-001, and AUDIT-FIND-W12-ACTIVE-001; batch-local checks passed and god-file guard reported 0 errors
ruff and py_compile for changed registry and focused tests - passed
validate_changes --require-worktree-coverage - passed before completion: 1118 packets valid
rollback_plan: Revert the registry loader and focused recovery-test changes, refresh generated summaries, and retain this packet as incomplete evidence if rollback occurs.
notes:
Finding disposition before remediation: confirmed. Linked audit errors remain immutable historical evidence. Invariant: incomplete active ownership recovery must never enable new claims. Existing CoordinatorStateMixin already refuses startup and emits actionable repair/idle-confirmation guidance when load returns false. Required validation: corruption matrix, mixed active claims, rerun metadata, coordinator startup, claim/done/recovery integration, independent disposable proof, and strict packet coverage. No real media or multi-host network execution is required or authorized. Python impact: yes; active desktop network registry recovery only.
AUDIT-FIND-W01-018 red state: mixed active claims, startup refusal, and four ownership/config/metadata subcases failed before implementation. Active-job recovery is now all-or-nothing; ancillary historical statistics remain best-effort. Load errors are secret-redacted, single-line, and bounded to 500 characters. The recovery regressions live in a focused module so this batch does not grow the existing in-flight registry god file.
Replaced the conflicting permissive-load regression with focused fail-closed recovery coverage and refreshed generated network inventory.
